findings.title: A downloaded file is executed in the same script
findings.message: downloaded file is executed directly without verification (found in documentation: this is what users are told to run)
findings.remediation: Verify the downloaded artifact with sha256sum or a signature from a key shipped in the repository before executing it, and pin the URL to an immutable release.

findings.title: A downloaded file is executed in the same script
findings.message: downloaded file is made executable (found in documentation: this is what users are told to run)
findings.remediation: Verify the downloaded artifact with sha256sum or a signature from a key shipped in the repository before executing it, and pin the URL to an immutable release.

findings.title: Obfuscated or dynamically constructed code is executed
findings.message: long base64 blob with a decoder present in the same file
findings.remediation: Replace encoded payloads with plain, reviewable source. Avoid eval; use arrays and functions instead.

findings.title: QML plugin spawns processes or touches files
findings.remediation: Keep process invocations minimal, avoid shells (bash -c), and never run privileged commands from a UI plugin.

findings.title: Omarchy plugin marketplace listing
findings.message: listed as 07dcolem.appimages (unverified); marketplace validated commit 5c7f68f3a11c; this commit matches the validated snapshot. Marketplace checks are a limited baseline, not a security audit.
findings.remediation: Compare the commit you install with the validated one; `omarchy plugin add` clones upstream HEAD, which is not verification-bound.

findings.title: Packages are installed
findings.message: pacman installs: git shellcheck shfmt bats desktop-file-utils jq perl python squashfs-tools (embedded in GitHub Actions run step)
findings.evidence: pacman -Sy --noconfirm --needed git shellcheck shfmt bats desktop-file-utils jq perl python squashfs-tools
findings.remediation: Prefer official repositories or the Omarchy package repo. For AUR packages, read the PKGBUILD. Avoid pacman -U from URLs.

findings.title: Omarchy shell plugin manifest validation
findings.message: valid Omarchy plugin manifest '07dcolem.appimages' (kinds: bar-widget, panel). Plugins run as unsandboxed code inside omarchy-shell with the user's full file and process access.
findings.remediation: Run `omarchy plugin validate <folder>` and fix every reported field before publishing.
